description: Aggregate rows are not people. A total person count or retention rate covering those rows is not identifiable from this snapshot.
requiredEvidence: Itemized source identities and longitudinal resolution; do not impute people from transaction counts.

description: A complete reviewed organizational-affiliation crosswalk has not been established. Similar names or employment fields are insufficient to assign industry ownership.
requiredEvidence: Official organizational records, effective dates and reviewed entity links.

description: Employment fields alone do not establish direction, reimbursement or coordination; occupation/employer missingness is material.
requiredEvidence: Separate individual giving from organizational funds; source-based case review and alternative explanations.

description: City strings do not identify neighborhoods or districts. No population-normalized neighborhood measure is published without an audited geographic crosswalk.
requiredEvidence: Official boundaries, Census denominators, validated geographic joins and missing-location sensitivity.

description: Commingled funds do not identify dollar-level provenance. Financial paths can be possible without being uniquely attributable.
requiredEvidence: Association-ledger review and bounded allocation scenarios; never present scenarios as tracing proof.

description: Campaign reports show committee payments, not the recipient’s cost structure or onward transfers.
requiredEvidence: Invoices, association details, reimbursement review and recipient financial records.

description: This comparison requires complete target-to-race allocation and a reviewed candidate-committee crosswalk, not just expenditure names.
requiredEvidence: Separate candidate-controlled spending from independent support/oppose allocations.

description: Program participation is selected, not randomly assigned; the current matched race sample does not support a causal effect estimate.
requiredEvidence: Comparable-campaign descriptive comparisons, selection analysis, validated local-donor definitions.

description: A change point does not identify intention. Election alignment and sufficient comparable pre/post observations are needed before calling a change strategic.
requiredEvidence: Prespecified event windows, reporting-lag checks and campaign-source corroboration.

description: The election has not happened at the September 27 cutoff. No outcome or causal analysis is possible.
requiredEvidence: No outcome model for pending elections.

description: A sufficiently complete certified-result and race crosswalk with pre-election finance windows has not yet been validated for this edition. A multilevel model without that foundation would be misleading.
requiredEvidence: Certified outcomes; race-appropriate single-seat versus multi-seat measures; grouped/temporal holdouts, regularization and uncertainty.

description: The current-version snapshot omits superseded amendments and deletions. Current Filed Date alone cannot reconstruct a past public view.
requiredEvidence: Historical version retrieval with original disclosure and amendment timestamps.

description: Official lobbying/consultant disclosure sources are located, but complete dated and reviewed entity joins have not been established. Name-only coincidences are not published as connections.
requiredEvidence: Verified public-record joins, effective dates and case-specific source review.

description: The transaction ledger cannot establish motive or causation. Even verified overlap needs plausible alternative explanations and defensible comparisons.
requiredEvidence: Dated decision records, policy context and a credible identification strategy; otherwise descriptive case studies only.

description: No. Exploratory anomalies require peer comparisons, multiple-testing controls and original-source review; normal reporting conventions can generate them.
requiredEvidence: Robust within-peer methods plus investigation log and counterevidence; no automated allegation labels.
